budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager reported a School Superintendent memorandum citing a FY25 budget surplus, and cautioned that the figure may be somewhat lower until the books close.
budget_items.quote: regarding a budget surplus of approximately $582,114.44 for fy25.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The reported surplus includes an encumbrance of about $114,000 for potential outstanding vendor invoices; the Town Manager said she did not expect the full amount to be real bills.
budget_items.quote: the reported surplus figure includes an approximately $114,000 encumbrance, representing potential outstanding vendor invoices

budget_items.topic: Return of unexpended funds to free cash
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Unexpended operating funds as of June 30 are returned and flow into certified free cash, and can be redirected only through Town Meeting; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: under massachusetts municipal finance law, any unexpended operating budget funds as of june 30th are returned and flow into certified free cash.

budget_items.topic: Flat Hill Road contract termination cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Canamach had submitted the lowest bid by a wide margin, and rebidding was expected to cost substantially more and require a new design team.
budget_items.quote: had submitted the lowest bid by several hundred thousand dollars

budget_items.topic: Flat Hill Road rebid cost and grant funding
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Rebidding was expected to cost substantially more; the Town is seeking a grant extension and may need more appropriations at a future Town Meeting. Chapter 90 funds were said to offset part of the gap; no figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: rebidding the project would likely result in substantially higher costs and would require a new design team

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Additional Chapter 90 funds received this year were said to help offset part of the Flat Hill Road funding gap; no figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: additional chapter 90 funds received this year would help offset some of that gap

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board of Assessors reported the growth assessed and the expected tax value from that growth, as reported by a Committee member.
budget_items.quote: residential, commercial, industrial, and chapter land growth was assessed at $27,324,570, with an expected tax value from growth of approximately $392,000

budget_items.topic: Litigation or settlement costs with Canamach
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A public commenter expressed concern that litigation or settlement costs with Canamach may be less than the contractor's liability under the contract; no figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: expressed concern that litigation or settlement costs with canamach may ultimately be less than the contractor's liability under the contract
